name: Product countdown
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product countdown. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Displays a merchant-configured deadline only; it does not create or end a Shopify discount. UTC offset is fixed and does not change for daylight saving time.
